title: Immediate-peer egress boundary for a pinned test topology
claim_scope: All immediate TCP peer attempts in the fixed disposable namespace fixture flow through a pinned gateway on the modeled trace. No bound on application payloads, allowed CONNECT destinations, other host deputies or real-world confidentiality.

threat_coverage.note: Peer reachability is narrower than confidentiality or prevention of host-deputy traffic.

runtime_correspondence.note: Fixture mutation controls support, not prove, Python/OS refinement.

environment_boundary.note: Kernel/host integrity and arbitrary destination process attribution are open.

lifetime_and_composition.note: No lifetime or multiple-worker budget theorem for this scenario.

usefulness.note: Pinned install/build/test fixture exercised (not a production or LinuxArena utility claim).

independent_review.note: Model reviewed; host deployment correspondence not independently certified.
